plugins.name: adage
plugins.description: Agent traces become reflexes: Adage compiles the paths your agents take into reflexes and tells them, deterministically, what to do next. Needs the adage binary on PATH (npm, Homebrew, or the release installers).

plugins.name: adage-exec
plugins.description: Adage with execution (E1 prefetch, opt-in): after `adage exec enable` and an approval per route, observe-only lookups run in an OS sandbox at the trigger and their typed output arrives beside the directive, and routes approved at E2 become MCP tools the agent calls. Replaces the Adage plugin's hooks while execution is on. Needs the adage and adage-exec binaries.
